name: prism
description: Run the Prism beads-backed story lifecycle directly in the host by deriving the current phase from Beads state.

interface.shortDescription: Beads-backed story lifecycle from current Beads phase state.
interface.longDescription: Guides coding agents through the Prism story lifecycle by reading the current Beads story state and advancing the next lifecycle phase in-host.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $prism:lifecycle to inspect the current Beads story state and advance the Prism lifecycle in this repository.
